Rider action: Choose a destination and compare connections.
Visible touchpoint: Phone: saved places, mode sequence and a clear estimate label.
Backstage activity: Normalize the dated operator references; calculate a proposed itinerary locally.
Recovery path: No route in coverage → explain the limit and offer Google Maps.

Rider action: Find the next leg without entering personal details.
Visible touchpoint: Kiosk: language choice, two-stop planner, visible assistance and a demo receipt.
Backstage activity: Keep the kiosk route and receipt in a separate in-memory session.
Responsible actor: Station operator in a future service
Recovery path: End session or reload → remove the kiosk selections and receipt.

Rider action: Confirm the route and understand ticket validity.
Visible touchpoint: Phone or receipt: route identity and an explicit demo restriction.
Backstage activity: Future operator payment and validator services would authorize travel.
Recovery path: Payment or scan fails → retain the itinerary and direct to staffed assistance.

Rider action: Recognize the next stop and prepare to leave.
Visible touchpoint: Vehicle display: next stop first, following stop, sequence and transfer cue.
Backstage activity: Prototype position advances manually. A future adapter would validate vehicle telemetry.
Responsible actor: Fleet control in a future service
Recovery path: Position becomes stale → suppress arrival predictions and show the route plus staff guidance.

Rider action: Find the next mode, then finish the trip.
Visible touchpoint: Consistent stop names across screens; Google Maps for external directions.
Backstage activity: The personal app stores completion locally and derives activity and insights.
Recovery path: Missed stop → re-plan from a known stop; no automatic fare or refund promise.
